content.short: ethers.js is a compact JavaScript library for interacting with the Ethereum blockchain.
content.description: Originally created within the Ethers ecosystem, Ethers.js has evolved into a compact, powerful library that enables DApps to fetch blockchain data and interact with the Ethereum network. It can serve as a full Ethereum wallet and gives developers access to the blockchain through block and wallet queries, ENS address resolution, direct connections to nodes, and more. Ethers.js currently powers more than 18,000 Web3 projects on GitHub.
